STEP 2 - Vessel: square white plate ~24 cm side; area ≈ 24 x 24 = 576 cm^2 (treat as dinner plate).

STEP 4 - Area: cheese 65% of vessel = 374 cm^2 (food covers ~65%, sum = 65%).

STEP 5 - Volume: 374 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 935 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: 935 ml x 0.9 g/ml = 842 g.

Reconsider the density: pieces are chunky with gaps, so 0.9 applied to the gross envelope as instructed.
Revised: 935 ml x 0.9 = 842 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: cheese 842 g x 260 kcal/100g = 2189 kcal (feta-like ~260 kcal/100g).

STEP 8 - Sanity check: 842 g of cheese on a dinner plate is high for what is visible; a heaped plate of cubed cheese at this scale is plausible but at the upper end, so the estimate is kept as computed.

Total: 842 g, 2189 kcal.
